Registry tests use block types defined here, which shows that\nthe loop never names a concrete type.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import blocks\nfrom mdparser.blocks import (\n    DOCUMENT,\n    PARAGRAPH,\n    Block,\n    BlockRegistry,\n    BlockType,\n    Cursor,\n    DocumentParser,\n    indent_columns,\n    next_column,\n    parse_lines,\n)\n\n\ndef kinds(block: Block) -> list[str]:\n    return [child.kind.name for child in block.children]\n\n\ndef paragraph_contents(block: Block) -> list[str]:\n    return [child.content for child in block.children if child.kind is PARAGRAPH]\n\n\n# --- Column helpers ---\n\n\ndef test_next_column_for_a_space_advances_one() -> None:\n    assert next_column(\" \", 3) == 4\n\n\ndef test_next_column_for_a_tab_advances_to_next_tab_stop() -> None:\n    assert next_column(\"\\t\", 0) == 4\n    assert next_column(\"\\t\", 2) == 4\n    assert next_column(\"\\t\", 4) == 8\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_counts_spaces() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"   x\", 0, 0) == 3\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_expands_a_leading_tab_to_four() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\tx\", 0, 0) == 4\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_pads_a_tab_after_spaces_to_the_tab_stop() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"  \\tx\", 0, 0) == 4\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_counts_two_tabs_as_eight() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\t\\tx\", 0, 0) == 8\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_is_zero_without_leading_whitespace() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"x  \", 0, 0) == 0\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_starts_from_the_given_column() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\tx\", 0, 2) == 2\n\n\n# --- Cursor ---\n\n\ndef test_cursor_rest_starts_as_the_whole_line() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"abc\").rest == \"abc\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_blank_for_empty_and_whitespace_lines() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\").is_blank()\n    assert Cursor(\" \\t \").is_blank()\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_not_blank_with_text() -> None:\n    assert not Cursor(\"  a\").is_blank()\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_nonspace_tracks_column_across_a_tab() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"  \\t x\")\n    cursor.advance_nonspace()\n    assert cursor.pos == 4\n    assert cursor.col == 5\n    assert cursor.rest == \"x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_columns_consumes_whole_tab_when_it_overshoots() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"\\tx\")\n    cursor.advance_columns(2)\n    assert cursor.pos == 1\n    assert cursor.col == 4\n    assert cursor.rest == \"x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_columns_stops_at_the_target_column() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"    x\")\n    cursor.advance_columns(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"  x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_indent_reports_columns_to_next_text() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\\t\\tx\").indent == 8\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_to_moves_by_characters() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"abc\")\n    cursor.advance_to(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"c\"\n\n\n# --- Empty and blank input ---\n\n\ndef test_empty_input_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_one_empty_line_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([\"\"]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_blank_lines_only_give_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([\"\", \"  \", \"\\t\", \" \\t \"]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_leading_and_trailing_blank_lines_add_no_blocks() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"\", \" \", \"word\", \"\", \"\\t\", \"\"])\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"word\"]\n\n\n# --- Paragraphs ---\n\n\ndef test_single_line_makes_one_paragraph() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"hello\"])\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"hello\"]\n\n\ndef test_blank_line_separates_paragraphs() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"\", \"two\"])\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"one\", \"two\"]\n\n\ndef test_repeated_blank_lines_separate_paragraphs_without_extra_blocks() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"two\"])\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\", \"paragraph\"]\n\n\ndef test_consecutive_lines_stay_in_one_paragraph() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"first\", \"second\", \"third\"])\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"first\\nsecond\\nthird\"]\n\n\ndef test_continuation_lines_drop_their_leading_indentation() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"first\", \"      second\", \"\\tthird\"])\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == test_paragraph_is_closed_when_document_ends() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"word\"])\n    assert all(not child.is_open for child in root.children)\n    assert not root.is_open\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_is_closed_by_a_blank_line_before_the_next_one() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"\", \"two\"])\n    assert [child.is_open for child in root.children] == [False, False]\n\n\ndef test_document_root_is_a_container_with_no_content() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"a\"])\n    assert root.kind is DOCUMENT\n    assert root.content == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_raw_lines_are_recorded_as_read() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"   two\"])\n    assert root.children[0].lines == [\"one\", \"two\"]\n\n\ndef _shape(root: Block) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return [(child.kind.name, child.content) for child in root.children]\n\n\ndef test_parsing_the_same_lines_twice_gives_the_same_tree() -> None:\n    lines = [\"a\", \"\", \"b\", \"c\"]\n    assert _shape(parse_lines(lines)) == _shape(parse_lines(lines))\n\n\n# --- Registry ---\n\n\ndef test_registry_rejects_a_duplicate_block_type_name() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        registry.register(PARAGRAPH)\n\n\ndef test_default_registry_start_rules_are_the_thematic_break() -> None:\n    assert blocks.DEFAULT_REGISTRY.starts() == (blocks.THEMATIC_BREAK,)\n\n\ndef test_lazy_block_type_must_accept_lines() -> None:\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        BlockType(\"bad\", continues=lambda block, cursor: True, lazy=True)\n\n\ndef test_leaf_block_type_must_have_an_add_line_rule() -> None:\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        BlockType(\"bad\", continues=lambda block, cursor: True, accepts_lines=True)\n\n\n# --- Extensibility: block types registered without changing the loop ---\n\n\ndef _rule_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    if cursor.rest.strip(\" \\t\") == \"***\":\n        cursor.advance_to(len(cursor.line))\n        return Block(RULE)\n    return None\n\n\nRULE = BlockType(\"rule\", continues=lambda block, cursor: False, start=_rule_start)\n\n\ndef test_registered_start_rule_interrupts_a_paragraph() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"a\", \"***\", \"b\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\", \"rule\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"a\", \"b\"]\n\n\ndef test_registered_start_rule_closes_an_unmatched_block_before_it_starts() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"***\", \"b\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"rule\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert root.children[0].is_open is False\n\n\ndef _raw_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    if cursor.rest.startswith(\"<<\"):\n        cursor.advance_to(len(cursor.line))\n        return Block(RAW)\n    return None\n\n\nRAW = BlockType(\n    \"raw\",\n    continues=lambda block, cursor: True,\n    accepts_lines=True,\n    add_line=lambda block, cursor: block.lines.append(cursor.rest),\n    start=_raw_start,\n)\n\n\ndef test_start_rule_is_not_tried_inside_a_non_interruptible_leaf() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RAW)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"<<\", \"***\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"raw\"]\n    assert root.children[0].lines[-1] == \"***\"\n\n\n# --- Lazy paragraph continuation, via a test-only container ---\n\n\ndef _quote_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    index = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    if cursor.line[index : index + 1] == \">\":\n        cursor.advance_to(index + 1)\n        return True\n    return False\n\n\ndef _quote_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    index = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    if cursor.line[index : index + 1] == \">\":\n The rest act on the\nblock tree returned by `parse_lines` and on the exact stdout bytes, which is the state handed back.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import ATX_HEADING, PARAGRAPH, parse_lines\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef kinds(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Names of the top-level block types that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child.kind.name for child in parse_lines(lines).children]\n\n\ndef render(project_root: Path, source: str) -> str:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    return result.stdout\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-ATX-Headings.md) ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"level\", range(1, 7))\ndef test_atx_levels_one_to_six(project_root: Path, level: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Each opening-sequence length from 1 to 6 renders exactly one heading of that level.\"\"\"\n    source = \"#\" * level + \" foo\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h\" + str(level) + \">\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_atx_not_a_heading(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Seven hashes, a missing space, and an escaped hash do not produce headings.\"\"\"\n    source = \"####### foo\\n\\n#hashtag\\n\\n\\\\## foo\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 3\n\n\ndef test_atx_closing_sequence(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A closing hash sequence is removed from the heading content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"## foo ##\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"#\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_atx_empty_heading(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Empty headings are allowed, one per line.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"#\\n\\n##\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_atx_interrupts_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A heading splits a paragraph without blank lines, leaving two paragraphs around it.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo bar\\n# baz\\nBar foo\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 2\n\n\ndef test_atx_indentation_limit(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Up to three spaces of indentation are allowed before the opening sequence, and four are not.\"\"\"\n    allowed = run_commonmark(project_root, \"   # foo\\n\")\n    refused = run_commonmark(project_root, \"    # foo\\n\")\n    print(allowed.stdout)\n    print(refused.stdout)\n    assert allowed.returncode == 0\n    assert refused.returncode == 0\n    assert allowed.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 1\n    assert refused.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n\n\n# --- Block tree: opening sequence ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"level\", range(1, 7))\ndef test_opening_run_of_each_length_is_a_heading(level: int) -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"#\" * level + \" foo\"]) == [ATX_HEADING.name]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"level\", range(1, 7))\ndef test_heading_block_records_its_level(level: int) -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"#\" * level + \" foo\"]).children\n    assert block.level == level\n\n\ndef test_seven_hashes_is_not_a_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"####### foo\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_hash_without_following_space_is_not_a_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"#hashtag\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_hash_followed_by_tab_is_a_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"#\\tfoo\"]) == [ATX_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_lone_hash_is_an_empty_heading() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"#\"]).children\n    assert block.kind is ATX_HEADING\n    assert block.level == 1\n    assert block.content == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"indent\", [1, 2, 3])\ndef test_up_to_three_spaces_of_indentation_form_a_heading(indent: int) -> None:\n    assert kinds([\" \" * indent + \"# foo\"]) == [ATX_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_four_spaces_of_indentation_is_not_a_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"    # foo\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_one_tab_of_indentation_is_not_a_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"\\t# foo\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_escaped_hash_is_not_a_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"\\\\# foo\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\n# --- Block tree: content and closing sequence ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"line\", \"content\"),\n    [\n        (\"# foo\", \"foo\"),\n        (\"#   foo   \", \"foo\"),\n        (\"#\\tfoo\\t\", \"foo\"),\n        (\"# foo ##\", \"foo\"),\n        (\"# foo #\", \"foo\"),\n        (\"# foo ##   \", \"foo\"),\n        (\"# foo \\t#\\t\", \"foo\"),\n        (\"# foo ## bar\", \"foo ## bar\"),\n        (\"# foo#\", \"foo#\"),\n        (\"# foo\\\\#\", \"foo\\\\#\"),\n        (\"# foo \\\\#\", \"foo \\\\#\"),\n        (\"# ##\", \"\"),\n        (\"# #\", \"\"),\n        (\"#\", \"\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_heading_content_after_stripping_and_closing_sequence(line: str, content: str) -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([line]).children\n    assert block.content == content\n\n\ndef test_heading_block_holds_no_children_or_lines() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"# foo\"]).children\n    assert block.children == []\n    assert block.lines == []\n\n\n# --- Block tree: interaction with paragraphs and neighbours ---\n\n\ndef test_heading_directly_after_paragraph_closes_the_paragraph() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"# bar\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name, ATX_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_resumes_after_heading_without_blank_line() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"# bar\", \"baz\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name, ATX_HEADING.name, PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_consecutive_headings_are_separate_blocks() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"# a\", \"## b\", \"### c\"]) == [ATX_HEADING.name] * 3\n\n\ndef test_heading_followed_by_blank_line_stays_one_block() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"# a\", \"\"]) == [ATX_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_text_after_heading_without_blank_line_is_a_new_paragraph() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"# a\", \"b\"]) == [ATX_HEADING.name, PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_indented_hash_after_paragraph_is_paragraph_text() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"    # bar\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\n# --- Exact output through the executable test_empty_headings_render_exactly(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert render(project_root, \"#\\n\\n##\\n\") == \"<h1></h1>\\n<h2></h2>\\n\"\n\n\ndef
